# Catalogos Maestros

## Scripts Principales

| Script | Objetivo | Entrada | Salida | Cuando Usarlo |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tools/init_chat.py` | Resolver chat activo y briefing | Fecha actual | `chats/chat_YYYY-MM-DD.md` | Inicio de sesion |
| `tools/devlog.py` | Ver o registrar hitos | CLI args | `devlog/DEVLOG.md` | Cierre de hito |
| `tools/memory_check.py` | Validar memoria versionada | `memory/` | Exit code y diagnostico | Tras cambios docs |
| `tools/snapshot_structure.py` | Regenerar TREE de estructura | Repo | `memory/STRUCTURE.md` | Nueva carpeta o archivo relevante |
| `tools/sync_inx_links.py` | Sincronizar enlaces INX | Fuente externa | INX Notion | Sync por fuente |
| `tools/timeline.py` | Agregar vista diaria | chats/devlog/artifacts | `artifacts/daily/` | Revision temporal |
| `bookdown/generate_static_html.py` | Render HTML del manual | `.Rmd` + `_bookdown.yml` | `bookdown/_book/index.html` | Tras editar manual |
| `bookdown/validate_static_html.py` | Validar artefacto HTML | HTML generado | Exit code | Antes de cerrar docs |

## Navegacion Por Intencion

| Quiero | Mira | Ejecuta |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Arrancar sesion de agente | `memory/INDEX.md` | `python tools/init_chat.py` |
| Ver tareas de hoy | `docs/todoist-agent.md` | `python apps/dashboard.py` |
| Diagnosticar Notion | `README.md` | `python apps/notion_doctor.py` |
| Ver trazabilidad | `docs/pipeline-atlas.md` | `python apps/inx_doctor.py` |
| Validar memoria | `memory/STRUCTURE.md` | `python tools/memory_check.py` |
| Publicar manual local | `bookdown/README.md` | `python bookdown/generate_static_html.py` |
